summary: Comprehensive testing of Digital Liberia full-stack app. All 20 backend pytest tests passed (health, services, initiatives, stats, contact CRUD/validation, newsletter idempotency/validation, no _id leak). All 9 frontend Playwright checks passed (home load, theme toggle + localStorage persistence, newsletter form, contact form submission, services hub search & sector filter, pillar detail navigation, mobile menu).
critical_code_review_comments: send_email currently logs warning when RESEND_API_KEY is missing — fine, but contact endpoint does not surface a generic 'service unavailable' note in payload; acceptable since email_sent boolean is exposed.
Pydantic ContactRecord.email is EmailStr while inserted into Mongo via model_dump — works because EmailStr serializes to str. No issue.
Newsletter idempotency relies on exact email match; consider lowercase/normalize emails to avoid 'A@x.com' vs 'a@x.com' duplicates (minor enhancement, not a bug).
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI — works but consider lifespan handlers (low priority).

Home.jsx IntersectionObserver uses '&& io.unobserve(e.target)' inside forEach with classList.add returning undefined — works due to short-circuit but fragile pattern; would be cleaner as separate statements (style only).
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed contact records and unique-email newsletter records via API; not cleaned up but isolated by unique IDs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_digital_liberia.py covers all 20 endpoints/cases. Resend email may return email_sent=false in test mode (acceptable); record persistence verified. Frontend tested at https://liberia-tech-future.preview.emergentagent.com — all data-testids functional. Contact form completes within ~1s in current env (Resend likely succeeded). No issues to retest.
